name: npreq
description: Read-only NP/APRN state requirement data for 56 US jurisdictions, with official sources, through your own NPReq API key.
long_description: NPReq answers questions about nurse practitioner (NP/APRN) state requirements: licensure, practice authority, continuing education hours and topics, renewal and prescribing, for 56 US jurisdictions, each value with the official board source it came from. Every tool is one read-only GET on the NPReq API. Your API key is kept in your system's credential store and is sent only to POST /v1/token on the API you choose. Not for clinical or licensing decisions; verify each value against its cited source.

tools.name: get_data_version
tools.description: The NPReq data set version, its last refresh time and the API version.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: One jurisdiction's requirements, with their official sources.

api_key.title: NPReq API key
api_key.description: Your NPReq API key (npq_live_..., or npq_test_... for staging). Stored in your system's credential store; sent only to POST /v1/token on the API below.

api_base.title: NPReq API
api_base.description: Which NPReq API the key is sent to: https://api.npreq.com (production, the default) or https://api-staging.npreq.com (staging, for npq_test_ keys). Any other value is refused and the server does not start; leave it empty for production.
